Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in interpreting the search results from the third search step. While the WebSurfer correctly identified that Crime and Punishment was "first published in 1866" (based on the initial serialization in the Russian magazine *The Russian Word*), the Planner explicitly stated in their analysis that "the first book publication was in 1867." This is a hallucination or a misinterpretation of the source text visible in the search results (which showed "first published in 1866"). By accepting this incorrect distinction (1866 vs 1867) and overriding the direct evidence from the Britannica snippet provided by the WebSurfer, the Planner concluded with the wrong year (1867) instead of the correct year (1866), which is the standard answer for the first publication of the novel (serialization counts as first publication).
